cells.gaps: The strategy was validated on 7 October 2026 (TCD-002) with amendments still to go to plenary before adoption (TCD-007). Ecofin's November report that the government approved it in October (TCD-011) gives no date or act, and its own October report found technical validation only (TCD-010).
cells.note: A draft validated at a workshop is still a draft, so the strategy reaches stage 2 and not 3. The one report of approval names no cabinet act and is contradicted by the October report of technical validation only.
